prompt:
카페에 아름다운 여성이 앉아있다.

동시에 같은 카페 테이블에 세 남자가 여성을 보고 작전 회의를 한다. (세 남자의 중심에서 얼굴을 비추는 빠른 여러번의 로우 앵글의 패닝 카메라 연출)

그중 한 남자가 일어나 그 여자에게 다가간다.

데이트를 요청하려는 순간 여자가 자리를 일어나 카페 밖으로 나가버린다.

남자는 다시 자리로 와서 아무일이 없었다는 듯 친구들과 깔깔댄다.

zones.name: Window Table
zones.description: A small square wooden table, two slender wooden chairs, a plain pale cup and saucer, a broad dark-framed window, and an unobstructed strip of concrete floor extending toward the neighboring friends’ table; the entrance is directly visible beside the window

zones.name: Friends’ Table
zones.description: A round wooden table with three chairs arranged around its wall-facing side, a pale plaster wall, a narrow wall shelf, and small pendant lights overhead; its open side faces the short stretch of floor leading to the window table

zones.name: Entrance
zones.description: A dark-framed glass door, a narrow glass sidelight, a dark floor mat, a shallow concrete threshold, and a pale strip of sidewalk outside; the window table is directly visible beside the doorway

baseline.lighting: soft window daylight with steady, subdued pendant lighting.

breakdown.logline: Encouraged by his two friends, a young man approaches a beautiful woman in a café to ask her out, but her departure interrupts his opening, sending him back to the table to disguise his embarrassment with shared laughter.

beats.summary: A woman’s quiet café visit attracts the attention of three men at a neighboring table
The three friends gather into a conspiratorial discussion
One friend singles out the tallest man to approach her
The tall man accepts the challenge and stands
He reaches the woman’s table and prepares to address her
The woman gets up and leaves before he can make his request
He returns to his friends and performs exaggerated nonchalance
All three dissolve into laughter, abandoning the pretense

subjects.name: Woman

signature_features: the combination of a narrow upper silhouette, long hair, and bell-shaped pale skirt remains recognizable from any angle.

subjects.name: Tall friend
subjects.appearance: notably tall and lanky, with a long torso; mid-gray shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, narrow charcoal trousers, and short dark hair

subjects.appearance: short, stocky build; closely cropped hair; pale crewneck sweater with a broad dark band continuing around the torso and upper arms; dark trousers

subjects.name: Broad friend
subjects.appearance: medium height, broad shoulders, dense rounded curls, charcoal hooded sweatshirt, and mid-gray trousers
signature_features: a wide upper-body silhouette, bulky hood, and dome of curls identify him from any angle.
